title: Data Scientist, EU Prime and Marketing Analytics & Science (PRIMAS)
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you passionate about giving customers the richest, most inspiring experience in their shopping journey? Do you like to dive deep to understand how customer-centric solutions drive measurable results? Do you enjoy working closely with the business and software engineers to design rigorous experiments, build the data infrastructure behind them, and translate results into decisions? You are in the right place! Come join our Prime & Marketing Analytics and Science (PRIMAS) team, where your work will directly impact millions of customers.  
  
The EU Marketing & Prime organization is looking for a Data Scientist to join the PRIMAS team. This role sits at the intersection of applied statistics and large-scale analytics — you'll design experiments and causal models, and also own the data pipelines, metrics, and reporting infrastructure that make those results usable across the business.  
  
The PRIMAS team provides a comprehensive understanding of customer segments, affinities, and lifetime value. We use data science tools and advanced statistical techniques to study customer purchase and engagement behaviors, and generate actionable insights on where, when, and how we deliver products and programs to customers. We help increase customer engagement, sales, and marketing efficiency, and our systems are built entirely in-house on automated large-scale analytics infrastructure. You will design, launch, and measure experiments across marketing channels (SEM/SEO, Affiliates, Display, Social, Mobile, Email, Onsite, etc.), engagement products, and customer segments. You will improve our understanding of customer behavior, run rigorous power and minimum detectable effect (MDE) analyses to size experiments correctly, and build the causal and conversion models that value and target our marketing — then build the pipelines and dashboards that keep those signals flowing reliably to stakeholders and downstream systems. You will work at the forefront of consumer analytics, tackling some of the hardest measurement problems in the industry alongside strong scientists, statisticians, and software engineers.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
1. Design and implement scalable, statistically rigorous experiments (A/B, geo, holdout, quasi-experiments) to measure marketing incrementality across channels.  
2. Perform power analysis and minimum detectable effect (MDE) calculations to determine experiment sample sizes, durations, and design trade-offs before launch.  
3. Build causal and treatment-effect models that produce conversion and valuation signals consumed by downstream bidding and budgeting systems.  
4. Building the ETL, metric definitions, and datasets that make results scalable, extensible, and repeatable rather than one-off analyses.  
5. Develop measurement frameworks that quantify the true, platform-independent contribution of marketing over time, and build the dashboards and reporting that keep those metrics visible to the business.  
6. Apply statistical, mathematical, and machine learning techniques to solve ambiguous business problems where the right approach isn't obvious.  
7. Analyze experiment results for validity — inspecting distributions, checking for sample ratio mismatch, exploring covariate balance, and tracking down the source of anomalies.  
8. Communicate experiment design, results, and trade-offs clearly to business and leadership audiences, including inputs into business reviews, and influence decisions and technical direction across teams.  
9. Establish scalable, repeatable processes and best practices for experiment design, data modeling, and analysis.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 1+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience
* 2+ years of data/research scientist, statistician or quantitative analyst in an internet-based company with complex and big data sources experience
* 1+ years of creating or contributing to mathematical textbooks, research papers, or educational content experience
* Master's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM), or experience working in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Ph.D. in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)
* Knowledge of statistical packages and business intelligence tools such as SPSS, SAS, S-PLUS, or R
* Knowledge of machine learning concepts and their application to reasoning and problem-solving
* Experience with clustered data processing (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, Map-reduce, and Hive)
* Experience working with or evaluating AI systems
* Experience applying quantitative analysis to solve business problems and making data-driven business decisions
* Experience effectively communicating complex concepts through written and verbal communication

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Data Scientist – AI & Quality Assurance
description:
**Position Overview**

AriveGuru is seeking a Data Scientist with combined expertise in Artificial Intelligence and Quality Assurance. The selected candidate will be responsible for developing data science and machine learning solutions and for ensuring that every AI-driven capability we release meets defined standards of accuracy, reliability and consistency.

This is a hybrid position. Candidates must demonstrate working proficiency in both AI/data science and software quality assurance practices.

Key Responsibilities

**AI and Data Science**

* Develop, test and refine machine learning and LLM-based solutions, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), classification and information extraction
* Perform data analysis, cleaning and preparation to support model development and evaluation
* Design and iterate on prompts using structured, repeatable testing methods

**AI Quality Assurance and Evaluation**

* Design evaluation datasets, reference (“golden”) answers and test cases to measure the accuracy, relevance and consistency of AI outputs
* Define quality metrics, acceptance criteria and release thresholds for AI-driven features
* Build automated evaluation and regression-testing pipelines in Python, integrated into the development and release workflow
* Identify, document and report failure modes, including hallucinations, incomplete or incorrect responses, bias and formatting errors, and coordinate with engineering teams on resolution
* Apply LLM-as-a-judge methods and calibrate automated scoring against human review
* Monitor production performance, detect model drift and quality degradation, and escalate issues promptly
* Validate the completeness, consistency and correctness of datasets used by our systems

**Collaboration and Reporting**

* Partner with backend, full stack and product teams to establish quality standards and release criteria
* Prepare clear dashboards, reports and documentation of evaluation results for technical and non-technical stakeholders

Required Qualifications

The position requires proficiency in both AI/data science and quality assurance. Applicants with experience in only one area will not be considered.

**AI and Data Science**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics or a related discipline
* Approximately 2 years of hands-on experience in data science, machine learning or AI projects
* Strong proficiency in Python and its data libraries (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn)
* Good working knowledge of SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL
* Sound understanding of machine learning fundamentals, statistics and evaluation metrics (precision, recall, F1 score, etc.)
* Practical experience with large language models, including prompt engineering, RAG, and an understanding of hallucination and grounding

**Quality Assurance**

* Working knowledge of QA fundamentals: test planning, test case design, edge-case analysis, defect reporting and regression testing
* Experience testing AI or ML outputs for accuracy, consistency and bias
* Ability to build automated tests and evaluation pipelines in Python
* Experience in data quality validation
* Ability to define pass/fail criteria and release standards
* Strong attention to detail and a disciplined, evidence-based approach to verifying results

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with evaluation frameworks such as Ragas, DeepEval or LangSmith
* Familiarity with LangChain or LlamaIndex
* Knowledge of test automation and API testing tools (Pytest, Postman, Selenium or equivalent)
* Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines and AWS
* Data visualization skills (Matplotlib, Plotly, Power BI or equivalent)
* Exposure to NLP, embeddings and vector databases

Desired Attributes

* Analytical, detail-oriented and methodical
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment
* Commitment to continuous learning, including effective use of modern AI tools
* High sense of ownership and accountability for quality

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on production-grade AI systems where quality standards directly influence outcomes
* Exposure to the complete lifecycle of AI development, evaluation and deployment
* Defined career growth toward senior data science and AI quality leadership roles
* Close collaboration with the leadership and engineering teams

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Principal Engineer – AI Engineering
description:
GE Vernova is embracing cutting-edge technologies to streamline operations, improve customer experiences, and drive growth. As part of this vision, we are building a dedicated team to leverage Generative AI and redefine how we engage with our industry. The ultimate goal of the team is to automate prompting, develop a framework for prompting across use cases to maximize reuse as well as sharing across businesses.
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated and talented AI Engineer to join our dynamic team. The successful candidate will be responsible for creating and optimizing prompts for LLMs, collaborating with domain experts and end users to develop software solutions that address both internal and external needs. This position offers a great opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced technology and traditional industry, making a tangible impact on our business processes.
  
  
We are driving strategy and leading research & development efforts to execute on the business’s mission to help power the energy transition. We forge the collaborations and help invent the technologies required to electrify and decarbonize for a zero-carbon future.
  
Representing virtually every major scientific and engineering discipline, our researchers are collaborating with GE Vernova’s businesses, the U.S. government, and more than 420 entities at the forefront of technology to execute on 150+ energy focused projects. Collectively, these research programs and initiatives aim to solve near term technical challenges, deliver next generation product advances, and drive long term breakthrough innovation to enable more affordable, reliable, sustainable, and secure energy.

**Job Description**
===================

* Collaborate with domain experts to understand business needs and translate them into clear and effective LLM prompts.
* Develop, test, and refine prompts for a variety of use cases, ensuring high accuracy and relevance in generated outputs.
* Work closely with software developers to integrate LLM solutions into existing or new applications.
* Contribute to the development of a scalable framework for prompt engineering, promoting reuse and knowledge sharing across different business units.
* Assist in gathering and analyzing user feedback to continually improve prompt effectiveness.
* Stay up-to-date with advancements in LLM technology and contribute to strategic decisions on tool and platform selection.
Document prompt engineering processes, best practices, and use case outcomes to build a comprehensive knowledge base.  

**Qualifications/Requirements:**

* **Master’s degree** in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science,, AI Engineering, Mathematics, or related field with **15+ years' relevant experience.**
* Experience with prompt engineering and familiarity with tools such as OpenAI’s GPT models, Hugging Face, etc.
* Proficiency in Python or other programming languages commonly used in AI/ML development.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and adapt to changing project requirements.
Candidate must be willing to travel a minimum of 2 weeks per year  

**Ideal Candidate Characteristics:**

* PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI Engineering, or related field
* Experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch) and data processing libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy).
* Previous experience or internships involving NLP or machine learning projects.
* Familiarity with version control systems like Git.
* Understanding of traditional industry operations and challenges.

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

title: Applied AI Solutions Engineer – PHB Commercial Transformation
description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**




At Novonesis, we believe biology holds the key to solving some of the world's biggest challenges. To unlock that potential, we are scaling AI capabilities that help our sales, marketing, and technical service teams work smarter, serve customers better, and create measurable business impact.

As an **Applied AI Solutions Engineer** , you will join the Strategy Deployment team within the Planetary Health Biosolutions (PHB) business division. Working at the intersection of applied AI, commercial problem-solving, and business transformation, you will help turn high-value opportunities into practical AI solutions that transform how commercial teams operate.

This is a forward-deployed engineering opportunity for someone who wants to combine strong technical expertise with visible business impact. You will move between commercial workflows, solution design, and hands-on development, owning the journey from identifying a business challenge to delivering solutions that users genuinely adopt and value.

**The Role & Your Impact**

In this role, you will design, build, deploy, and continuously improve AI solutions that enable PHB commercial teams to work more effectively and create measurable business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI Solution Development**

* Work directly with PHB commercial teams to understand workflows, user needs, and business challenges, translating them into practical AI solutions.
* Design and build AI agents, applications, and workflows utilizing prompting, grounding, retrieval, tool usage, actions, and orchestration.
* Develop thin-slice solutions to rapidly validate user value and technical feasibility.
* Build iteratively with users, leveraging feedback and evidence to improve, redesign, or discontinue solutions where appropriate.

**Integration & Engineering**

* Securely connect AI solutions to enterprise platforms and data sources, including Salesforce, Microsoft 365, and approved AI services.
* Build integrations using APIs, connectors, and workflow technologies with appropriate identity, security, and approval controls.
* Work with structured and unstructured data, enterprise knowledge sources, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns.
* Design and develop solutions with security, privacy, responsible AI, maintainability, and reuse in mind.

**Evaluation, Deployment & Scale**

* Design and execute functional, integration, regression, and AI-specific evaluations covering groundedness, retrieval quality, agent behavior, reliability, and user experience.
* Test solutions with end users and make data-driven decisions on whether to scale, iterate, or stop initiatives.
* Deploy, monitor, support, and continuously improve production solutions in partnership with Central IT, ComEx, and other enterprise stakeholders.
* Document solutions, technical patterns, and key learnings to support ongoing maintenance, reuse, and scale across the organization.

**What You'll Need to Be Successful**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2–6 years of relevant professional experience building and deploying AI, GenAI, or agent-based solutions in production environments.
* Hands-on experience with LLMs, AI agents, prompting, grounding, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool use, and orchestration frameworks.
* Strong programming skills in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Experience working with APIs, data integration, Git/version control, testing practices, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience building workflows and integrations using technologies such as Microsoft Power Platform, Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, Salesforce Flow, REST APIs, or similar tools.
* Experience taking AI solutions from prototype through deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
* Good understanding of cloud platforms, identity and access management, secure enterprise data handling, responsible AI, and production reliability.
* Ability to work directly with business users and technical teams to translate business challenges into practical technology solutions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Salesforce Agentforce, UiPath, or comparable technologies.
* Experience supporting sales, marketing, customer engagement, or commercial business functions.
* Curiosity and adaptability to work across different AI models, platforms, and frameworks while selecting the best technology for the business problem.
* Experience working in fast-paced environments with evolving priorities and emerging technologies.

What We Offer

At Novonesis, you will help shape how AI transforms commercial operations across a global, purpose-driven organization. You will work alongside experienced colleagues, gain exposure to cutting-edge AI technologies, and contribute to solutions that create tangible value for customers and the business.

We offer an environment that encourages innovation, learning, ownership, and professional growth while supporting our purpose of unlocking the power of biology to address global challenges.

**Application Deadline:** November 23rd November 2026 - *We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.*

**Our purpose guides the way**

In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.

**Opportunities for everyone**

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.

**Explore other openings**

If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

You will work directly with business stakeholders, technical teams, and enterprise partners to solve meaningful problems and accelerate the adoption of AI across commercial functions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI Solution Development & Commercial Transformation**

* Partner with PHB commercial teams to understand complex workflows, business challenges, and user needs.
* Translate opportunities into practical AI solutions that create measurable business value.
* Design and build AI agents, applications, and workflows leveraging prompting, grounding, retrieval, tool use, actions, and orchestration.
* Develop and validate thin-slice solutions to assess user value and technical feasibility.
* Iterate rapidly based on user feedback and business outcomes.
* Lead multiple AI initiatives simultaneously, owning technical direction and delivery outcomes.
* You will work alongside other Applied AI engineers who also run projects independently. Your distinction will be the ability to take on the assignments with the greatest ambiguity, integration complexity, enterprise risk or cross-functional scope, while helping establish reusable technical patterns and a consistently high engineering and evaluation bar across the team.

**Integration & Engineering**

* Define solution architectures for complex enterprise use cases and evaluate trade-offs across custom applications, Microsoft platforms, Salesforce capabilities, enterprise services, and third-party providers.
* Integrate AI solutions securely with enterprise platforms including Microsoft 365, Salesforce, and approved AI services.
* Build integrations using APIs, connectors, and workflow technologies while implementing appropriate identity, authorization, and approval controls.
* Develop solutions utilizing both structured and unstructured data, enterprise knowledge repositories, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns.
* Ensure solutions are secure, scalable, maintainable, reusable, and aligned with responsible AI principles.

**Evaluation, Deployment & Scaling**

* Establish evaluation methodologies, quality standards, and release criteria for AI solutions.
* Design and execute functional, integration, regression, and AI-specific evaluations covering reliability, groundedness, retrieval quality, agent behavior, and user experience.
* Validate solutions with users and determine whether to scale, iterate, or discontinue initiatives based on evidence.
* Deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve production solutions.
* Document architectures, patterns, and learnings to support future reuse and scale across the organization.

**What You'll Need to Be Successful**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4–8 years of relevant professional experience building and deploying AI, GenAI, or agent-based solutions in real-world environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, prompting, grounding, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool use, and orchestration techniques.
* Strong programming skills in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Experience with APIs, data integration, version control (Git), testing, and CI/CD practices.
* Experience building enterprise workflows and integrations using technologies such as Microsoft Power Platform, Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, Salesforce Flow, REST APIs, or comparable solutions.
* Experience taking AI solutions from prototype to production, including testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Understanding of cloud platforms, identity and access management, secure data handling, responsible AI, and operational reliability.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Salesforce Agentforce, UiPath, or similar enterprise AI platforms.
* Experience working with commercial, sales, marketing, or customer-facing business functions.
* Demonstrated ability to select appropriate technologies based on business outcomes rather than platform preference.
* Experience operating effectively in highly ambiguous and fast-changing environments.

What We Offer

At Novonesis, you will help shape how AI transforms commercial operations across a global, purpose-driven organization. You will work alongside experienced colleagues, gain exposure to cutting-edge AI technologies, and contribute to solutions that create tangible value for customers and the business.

We offer an environment that encourages innovation, learning, ownership, and professional growth while supporting our purpose of unlocking the power of biology to address global challenges.

In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. title: Principal Data Scientist
description:
### **Job Title**

Principal Data Scientist

### **Job Description**

**Job title:**  
**Principal Data Scientist**

**Your role:**  
The Performance Analytics & AI Business Partner combines deep commercial understanding with strong hands-on expertise in data science, machine learning, Generative AI and agentic AI. The role is accountable for turning complex performance data into trusted decisions, scalable analytics products and intelligent tools that help Business Units and Regions sense, diagnose, predict and act faster.

The role owns the performance-analytics foundation: sell-out and market data from syndicated vendors such as Circana, GfK, Nielsen and IQVIA; performance dashboards; data definitions; and the business narrative behind the numbers. It also leads the evolution beyond traditional reporting by building advanced analytical models, AI agents and conversational decision-support tools.

This is not a reporting role and not a purely technical data-scientist role. It requires someone who can build robust analytical solutions, understand the underlying data and models, and confidently influence senior commercial leaders with clear “so what / now what” recommendations.

  

**Job Responsibilities:**

  

1. Performance Analytics Business Partnering

* Act as the day-to-day performance analytics partner for assigned Businesses and Regions.
* Translate leadership questions into clear analytics, data-science and AI solution requirements.
* Lead analysis across market share, sell-in, sell-out, revenue, margin, price, mix, distribution, customer and channel performance.
* Support business reviews, planning cycles, forecasts and strategic discussions with fact-based insights and recommendations.
* Connect multiple performance signals to identify underlying drivers, risks, opportunities and required actions.
Challenge assumptions constructively and translate complex analysis into concise executive narratives.  

  

2. Syndicated Data, Data Foundations and Governance

* Own the business use, interpretation and quality of syndicated market and sell-out data from Circana, GfK, Nielsen, IQVIA and other relevant vendors.
* Understand and manage data methodologies, coverage, definitions, assumptions and limitations.
* Work with Data & Technology, data engineering and external providers to integrate, validate and harmonise data in ADL and related platforms.
* Establish robust reconciliation, validation and quality-control processes to ensure performance outputs are trusted and first-time-right.
* Define common business rules, hierarchies, calculations and performance definitions across Businesses and Regions.
Document data logic, methodologies and known limitations clearly.  

  

3. Dashboards and Analytics Products

* Own and continuously improve sell-out and commercial performance dashboards as analytics products, not static reports.
* Build scalable, reusable dashboards and automated analytical workflows using SQL, Python and modern BI tools.
* Move dashboards beyond reporting by embedding automated diagnostics, alerts, benchmarks, root-cause analysis and recommended actions.
* Lead requirements gathering, design, user testing, deployment and adoption of analytics products.
* Simplify the dashboard landscape by eliminating duplicate, manual and low-value reporting.
Monitor solution usage, user feedback, data quality and business impact, and continuously improve the product backlog.  

  

4. Advanced Analytics and Data Science

* Analyse complex, high-volume structured and unstructured datasets using robust statistical and data-science methods.
* Develop and deploy predictive and diagnostic models for commercial performance questions, including forecasting, regression, classification, clustering, anomaly detection, price and mix analysis.
* Own the end-to-end data-science lifecycle: problem framing, data preparation, feature engineering, model development, validation, deployment, monitoring and improvement.
* Assess model performance, stability, explainability and business relevance before scaling solutions.
* Apply scientific rigour to distinguish correlation, decomposition and causal insight; ensure models are used appropriately in decision-making.
Write clean, documented and reusable code, and partner with technical teams to productionise analytical solutions.  

  

5. AI, GenAI and Agentic Decision Intelligence

* Design, build and deploy AI-enabled tools, Generative AI applications and analytical agents for performance management.
* Use LLMs, retrieval-based approaches, machine learning and automation to enable users to ask business questions in natural language and receive trusted, grounded answers.
* Create agents that can monitor performance, identify deviations, retrieve relevant context, diagnose likely drivers, simulate scenarios and recommend next-best actions.
* Combine dashboards, predictive models and conversational AI into intuitive decision-support experiences.
* Rapidly prototype AI use cases, test them with users and scale successful solutions into robust products.
* Apply responsible-AI principles, including data security, access control, traceability, explainability, evaluation, bias awareness and clear human decision rights.
Stay current on developments in AI, LLMs, agentic frameworks and data science, applying innovations pragmatically where they create measurable value.  

  

6. Technology, Deployment and Solution Architecture

* Partner with IT, data engineering, software development and platform teams to ensure analytical and AI solutions are secure, scalable, reliable and aligned with enterprise standards.
* Define technical requirements, support solution architecture, testing and production deployment.
* Establish appropriate model monitoring, version control, documentation and evaluation processes.
* Resolve data and technical issues that affect the reliability, speed or usability of analytics products.
Balance rapid MVP delivery with sound product-engineering fundamentals.  

  

7. Adoption and Capability Building

* Drive adoption of dashboards, models and AI tools through training, coaching, clear playbooks and active engagement with business users.
* Build confidence in data, analytical methods and AI recommendations by making logic and limitations transparent.
* Help stakeholders use performance insight consistently in business reviews, planning, customer discussions and commercial decisions.
* Share best practices across Businesses, Regions and analytics teams.
Track whether insights and AI tools lead to decisions, actions and measurable business impact.  

  

Success Measures

* Trusted, consistent and timely sell-out and market-performance insights across Businesses and Regions.
* High adoption and demonstrable impact of dashboards, analytics products and AI-enabled tools.
* Reduced manual reporting and duplicate analytics solutions.
* Earlier identification of performance risks and growth opportunities.
* Increased use of predictive analytics, AI agents and automated diagnostics in regular business routines.
* Strong data quality, governance, model reliability and responsible-AI compliance.
* Clear evidence that analytical recommendations translate into business decisions and commercial impact.
Positive feedback from senior Business, Regional, Sales, Marketing and Finance stakeholders.  

**You're the right fit if:**

Experience

* Approximately 8–12 years of experience in performance analytics, commercial analytics, data science, decision intelligence, business intelligence or a related field.
* Proven experience with syndicated market or sell-out data, such as Circana, GfK, Nielsen, IQVIA or equivalent.
* Demonstrated experience building and deploying analytics products, dashboards, predictive models or AI-enabled tools—not only consuming reports.
* Strong experience partnering with senior commercial stakeholders and influencing decisions without direct authority.
* Experience working across multiple markets, categories or Business Units in a complex matrix organisation.
Experience taking analytical solutions from business problem through build, deployment, adoption and measurable impact.  

  

Technical and Analytical Expertise

* Expert-level hands-on capability in Python and SQL, with strong foundations in statistics, data modelling and data quality.
* Strong practical expertise in machine learning, including regression, forecasting, classification, clustering, anomaly detection and model evaluation.
* Strong working expertise in Generative AI, LLMs, prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation, AI-agent design and evaluation.
* Experience building AI or GenAI applications, ideally including conversational analytics, intelligent assistants or agentic workflows.
* Experience with BI and visualisation tools, cloud data platforms, data lakes/ADL and enterprise data environments.
Understanding of data governance, model governance, responsible AI, deployment and monitoring practices.  

  

Business and Personal Skills

* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to connect analytical findings to performance, decisions and actions.
* Ability to turn complex data science and AI outputs into simple, compelling executive stories.
* High ownership and a builder mindset; comfortable moving rapidly from idea to MVP to scaled solution.
* Curious, pragmatic and rigorous—able to use advanced technology without over-engineering.
Strong stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills.  

  

Education

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics, Econometrics, Engineering, Mathematics or another quantitative discipline.
Additional education or demonstrated hands-on expertise in machine learning, GenAI, LLMs or AI-product development is strongly preferred.  

**How we work together**  
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

**About Philips**  
Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business , discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose .
  
If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care .

Our team is comprised of talented applied scientists, developers, testers, program managers, designers and product managers tasked with the singular goal to create THE world's best buying experience.
  
Scientists on this team develop the next-generation technologies and experiences that change how millions interact and shop online. The Associate Director of AI Science is a highly strategic, business-facing leadership role dedicated to driving commercial value across our Home and Mobility verticals. Sitting at the intersection of advanced machine learning and business strategy, this role focuses on leveraging propensity modeling and dynamic microsegmentation to unlock new revenue streams, optimize the customer lifecycle, and elevate customer lifetime value.

You will act as the crucial bridge between our technical AI Science teams and the Home and Mobility business units, ensuring that complex AI and data science capabilities are translated into adopted, scalable solutions that deliver measurable ROI and continuous business growth.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Business Strategy & Commercial Value Creation**

* **Monetize AI Capabilities:** Lead the strategic application of advanced propensity models (e.g., likelihood-to-buy, churn prediction, next-best-action, cross-sell/up-sell) to drive tangible growth and retention in the Home and Mobility sectors.
* **Define Microsegmentation Strategy:** Guide the development of highly granular, behavioral microsegments to personalize marketing efforts, optimize pricing strategies, and tailor product offerings in real-time.
* **ROI Accountability:** Establish frameworks to measure the commercial impact of deployed AI models. Define, track, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) that demonstrate direct value creation, revenue lift, and cost optimization.
* **Lifecycle Optimization:** Embed AI-driven insights into critical touchpoints along the customer lifecycle, ensuring predictive interventions are timed perfectly with high-impact trigger events.

**Stakeholder Management & AI Adoption**

* **Executive Liaison:** Serve as the primary strategic advisor and translator between the AI Science function and Home/Mobility business leaders (Marketing, Product, Sales, and Customer Experience).
* **Drive Business Adoption:** Champion the operationalization of AI models. Overcome organizational silos and resistance by demonstrating clear business value, securing buy-in, and embedding AI tools directly into end-user workflows.
* **Storytelling with Data:** Translate highly technical machine learning concepts, model performance metrics, and statistical outputs into clear, compelling narratives and strategic recommendations for senior executive leadership.
* **Needs Translation:** Proactively identify business pain points within Home and Mobility and translate these into actionable data science projects, defining clear modeling requirements for the technical teams.

**Technical Oversight & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* **Model Lifecycle Strategy:** Oversee the business strategy for models deployed in high-impact areas, ensuring continuous optimization, accuracy, and relevance to shifting market dynamics.
* **Pipeline Integration:** Partner closely with Data Engineering, MLOps, and IT teams to ensure models are seamlessly deployed into production environments and marketing automation platforms.
* **Team Mentorship:** Provide strategic direction and business-context mentorship to data scientists and AI engineers, ensuring their technical execution remains tightly aligned with corporate objectives.

### **Core Competencies & Qualifications**

**Experience & Education**

* **Education:** Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, or a related field (an MBA with a strong quantitative focus is highly preferred).
* **Industry Experience:** 8+ years of experience in data science, advanced analytics, or AI strategy, with a minimum of 3 years in a leadership, product management, or business-facing role.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Deep understanding of the telecommunications, broadband, or consumer technology industries, specifically within Home (e.g., fiber, smart home, IoT) and Mobility (e.g., 5G, wireless services) verticals.

**Technical & Business Skills**

* **AI/ML Fluency:** Strong foundational understanding of machine learning algorithms, deep learning, NLP, and LLM architecture. Must be highly conversant in how techniques utilizing frameworks like PyTorch and scikit-learn are applied to business problems, even if not writing production code daily.
* **Advanced Propensity & Segmentation:** Proven track record of designing, evaluating, and strategically deploying end-to-end propensity models and clustering techniques for large-scale customer bases.
* **Data Stack Familiarity:** Experience working with cloud platforms (e.g., GCP, AWS, Azure), production MLOps tools, and large-scale data extraction processes.
* **Exceptional Communication:** Elite presentation skills with the ability to distill complex analytical findings into actionable business strategies for non-technical stakeholders.

### **What Success Looks Like in Year One**

* Successfully integrated at least three major propensity or microsegmentation models into the Home and Mobility go-to-market workflows.
* Established a regular cadence of AI performance reporting that clearly demonstrates incremental revenue lift or churn reduction to the executive team.
* Achieved a high adoption rate of AI-driven recommendations among business stakeholders, shifting the organizational culture toward proactive, model-driven decision-making.

### **Where you’ll be working**

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

### **Scheduled Weekly Hours**

40

### **Equal Employment Opportunity**

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: AI Governance, Senior Associate
description:
Huron is redefining what a global consulting organization can be. Advancing new ideas every day to build even stronger clients, individuals and communities. We’re helping our clients find new ways to drive growth, enhance business performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. And, we’re developing strategies and implementing solutions that enable the transformative change they need to own their future.  
  
As a member of the Huron corporate team, you’ll help to evolve our business model to stay ahead of market forces, industry trends and client needs. Our accounting, finance, human resources, IT, legal, marketing and facilities management professionals work collaboratively to support Huron’s collective strategies and enable real transformation to produce sustainable business results.  
  
Join our team and create your future.

As AI adoption accelerates across the firm, an AI Governance Sr. Associate is needed to identify and refine the security controls, governance processes, and risk assessment practices necessary to ensure Huron leverages AI technologies in a manner that is consistent with our existing commitments to Privacy and Security.  
  
Description  
  
This individual is responsible for developing a scaled and consistent approach to: AI security controls, governance processes, risk assessments, and standards. The role requires close coordination with stakeholders across IT, Legal, Procurement, and the business units to ensure AI initiatives are evaluated for risk early, governed consistently, and supported with clear, practical standards and safeguards. The individual should be comfortable operating in an evolving regulatory and technical landscape, translating emerging AI risk concepts into practical governance structures that all stakeholders can rapidly adopt.

Key Responsibilities

AI security controls

* Develop and maintain security controls that are consistent with existing Huron standards specific to AI, including but not limited to agents, systems, models, AI-enabled tools, data handling, access, and use.
* Partner with IT and AI Business Teams to embed security requirements into AI development, procurement, and deployment workflows.
* Evaluate third-party AI tools and vendors for security and data handling risk, in coordination with the third-party risk function.
* Monitor the AI threat landscape and recommend control updates as new risks and techniques emerge.

Governance processes and standards

* Develop and maintain AI governance processes, including intake, approval, and ongoing oversight for new AI use cases.
* Draft and maintain AI security standards, policies, and playbooks, keeping them current with regulatory and technical change.
* Support the AI Governance Committee or designated AI oversight structure, coordinating review cadence and documentation.
* Develop AI governance metrics and provide regular reporting on program maturity and open items.

Risk assessments

* Conduct risk assessments of new and existing AI use cases, evaluating data sensitivity, and business impact.
* Identify and track remediation items arising from AI risk assessments, driving them to closure, with business and technical owners.
* Support due diligence on AI features embedded in existing or prospective vendor products.
* Help ensure AI risk assessments align with applicable regulatory, privacy, and industry requirements.

Stakeholder coordination

* Act as a point of contact for business units and technical teams seeking guidance on AI security and governance requirements.
* Communicate AI risk findings, standards, and process requirements clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Collaborate with Legal and Compliance on AI-related regulatory obligations and disclosure requirements.
* Build relationships across the business to help AI governance keep pace with adoption while supporting compliant innovation.

Qualifications

* 3 to 5+ years of experience in information security, GRC, or risk management, with meaningful exposure to AI, machine learning, and/or data governance.
* Undergraduate degree required, preferably in Information Security, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* ISO 42001 Lead Auditor/ Lead Implementor Certification
* Working knowledge of AI risk concepts (model risk, data lineage, bias, explainability) and how they map to security controls.
* Familiarity with emerging AI governance frameworks and regulations (e.g., NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, ISO/IEC 27090:2026, EU AI Act) and the ability to translate them into practical standards.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical AI risk concepts to business stakeholders.
* Experienced in designing and implementing governance frameworks in dynamic, fast-paced environments while maintaining strong risk oversight.

Preferred Skills

* Security or AI governance certification, such as CRISC or AIGP, AAIA, AAISM, AAIR
* Experience standing up or maturing a governance program from an early stage.
* Foundational knowledge of Application Security (App Sec) frameworks (e.g. OWASP, NIST SSDF, CIS) as well as ability to integrate Secure-System Lifecycle and Design into AI workflows.
* Familiarity with GRC or risk management platforms used to track assessments and remediation items.
* Analytical problem-solving skills, including the ability to synthesize technical risk into a format that supports leadership decision-making.

Senior Associate

-----------

AI Risk Engineer on Chevron’s Responsible AI (RAI) team partners with business and IT development teams to help ensure that AI and machine learning systems—including third-party tools, generative AI, and AI agents—are fair, transparent, accountable, secure, and aligned with Chevron’s ethical principles. Working at the intersection of AI/ML engineering, ethics, and policy, you will build and maintain the automation, scripts, and tooling that power Chevron’s AI impact assessment process, and help operationalize Responsible AI controls within our AI governance platform (Credo AI). You will collaborate closely with our Cybersecurity, Legal, and Data Privacy teams to ensure that AI solutions, vendors, and internal use cases adhere to Chevron guidelines, policies, and emerging regulations.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Build, maintain, and enhance the automation flows, scripts, and tooling that support Chevron’s AI impact assessment and Responsible AI review processes.
* Configure and administer Chevron’s AI governance platform (Credo AI)—adding risk scenarios, controls, and review workflows that enable teams to document mitigations, provide evidence, and track AI risks across the lifecycle.
* Design and operate review and approval checkpoints, including pre-production questionnaires and periodic re-reviews of AI use cases, streamlining through automation where possible.
* Establish and run model review processes for both pre-trained/foundation models and custom-built machine learning models.
* Assist in AI Discovery and maintain an inventory of AI models, agents, and use cases across the enterprise, ensuring proper documentation and lifecycle governance.
* Conduct ethical risk assessments and impact analyses for AI use cases, including alignment with regulations such as the EU AI Act and industry frameworks such as the IOGP Responsible Use of AI principles, and NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
* Evaluate AI vendors, models, and external AI access requests for fairness, security, and policy compliance, partnering with Cybersecurity, Legal, and Data Privacy.
* Influence the development and adoption of tools and methodologies to detect and mitigate bias, drift, and unintended consequences in machine learning and generative AI systems.
* Lead training, FAQs, and awareness campaigns—leveraging Teams and Copilot—to promote ethical AI practices and communicate process changes across business units.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to integrate Responsible AI principles into product development and deployment workflows.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of professional experience in data science, analytics, or AI/ML engineering roles.
* Proficiency in Python and experience building automation, scripts, or data pipelines that integrate with enterprise platforms and APIs.
* Demonstrated ability to reason through ethical implications of AI systems and articulate trade-offs.
* Experience working with interdisciplinary teams (e.g., cybersecurity, legal, privacy, policy) to embed Responsible AI principles.
* Strong communication and presentation skills to convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Familiarity with data governance frameworks and enterprise compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, NIST, OECD).

**Must Have Skill**
-------------------

Python,Responsible AI,AI Governance

**Good to Have Skill**
----------------------

AI for Cybersecurity

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

* Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Certifications in Responsible AI, Data/AI Ethics, Cybersecurity, or AI Governance.
* Experience developing and evaluating machine learning models using Python and libraries such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
* Experience with generative AI or agentic AI frameworks, tools, or applications, and with governing AI agents (e.g., agent registries, Microsoft Agents 365).
* Experience with AI governance or model-risk platforms (e.g., Credo AI) and workflow automation (e.g., Power Automate, Azure DevOps).
* Knowledge of fairness, interpretability, and robustness techniques in AI.
* Experience with enterprise AI platforms (e.g., Azure ML / Azure AI Foundry, Databricks, DataRobot).
* Familiarity with emerging AI regulations and industry frameworks (e.g., EU AI Act, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, IOGP Responsible Use of AI).

* Proven ability to work autonomously in ambiguous environments and make connections between disparate data sources.
* **Must-have:**Python; familiarity AI system implementation; familiarity with policies related to AI governance

  **Good-to-have:**certification in RAI, data/AI ethics, cybersecurity, or AI governance; Oil & Gas domain.

title: Junior Data Scincetist
description:
**Job Requirements**  

**Role:**

To contribute to the end-to-end development and product lifecycle management of artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) systems as part of an R&D organization. The Junior Data Scientist supports the definition of intended algorithm performance, the development and curation of representative data and annotations, the development of AI/ML algorithms, and the generation of scientific evidence demonstrating stand-alone algorithm performance.

The candidate is expected to:

* Apply scientific, statistical, machine learning, and software engineering methods to develop and evaluate AI/ML algorithm components for defined product use cases.
* Work with experienced Data Scientists, product management, clinical or domain experts, software developers, and quality and regulatory functions to translate customer needs and the intended use into measurable algorithm performance targets.
* Support the definition, sourcing, curation, documentation, and maintenance of representative data cohorts and annotations required for training, tuning, and evaluation.
* Plan and execute reproducible scientific evaluations that provide objective evidence of algorithm performance, limitations, and suitability for the intended use.
* Contribute the Data Science work products and evidence required for integration of AI/ML algorithm components into products and for their verification, validation, regulatory release, and lifecycle monitoring.

**What are my responsibilities?**

As a Junior Data Scientist, you are required to:

* Support the finalization of product and algorithm concepts by translating customer needs, intended use, clinical or technical requirements, and applicable regulatory considerations into measurable state-of-the-art performance targets.
* Contribute to the definition of the AI/ML development and scientific evaluation strategy for assigned algorithm components under the guidance of experienced Data Scientists.
* Perform exploratory data analysis and data risk assessments to identify data gaps, quality issues, potential bias, confounding factors, outliers, and limitations that may affect algorithm development or evaluation.
* Define and document data needs for training, tuning, and evaluation, including relevant subgroups and acceptance criteria, so that data cohorts are representative of the intended use and aligned with the product and regulatory strategy.
* Support the specification of annotations, acceptance criteria, and quality controls; collaborate with qualified internal or external suppliers on sourcing data and annotations.
* Curate, version, maintain, and document representative data cohorts and ensure data provenance, traceability, quality, and fitness for purpose together with data management stakeholders.
* Design, implement, train, tune, and technically characterize AI/ML algorithm components using appropriate machine learning, deep learning, statistical, or generative AI methods.
* Define scientifically justified metrics, evaluation methods, test cases, and acceptance criteria to assess stand-alone algorithm performance, including relevant aspects such as accuracy, robustness, reliability, generalizability, explainability, bias, and subgroup performance.
* Implement and execute reproducible bench tests on representative evaluation cohorts and relevant subgroups as part of the verification and validation strategy.
* Analyze and interpret evaluation results, investigate failure modes, document residual limitations, and derive evidence-based recommendations for algorithm improvement and product decisions.
* Document development and evaluation activities and contribute to Data Science work products such as data management information, annotation specifications, scientific evaluation test cases, and scientific evaluation reports.
* Provide scientific evidence and technical input for product reviews and regulatory submissions and support responses to questions concerning data, annotations, evaluation methods, and stand-alone algorithm performance.
* Support the design and execution of clinical investigations, reader studies, or other studies when additional evidence is required by the product or regulatory strategy.
* Collaborate with software engineering and MLOps functions to establish reproducible pipelines, versioned artifacts, automated tests, controlled deployment, and integration of algorithm components into the product.
* Help define and implement monitoring metrics for detecting data anomalies, outliers, and algorithm performance drift across the product lifecycle.
* Regularly review advances in Data Science and AI and assess their applicability to the development and evaluation of AI/ML products.

**Qualification:**

Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Biomedical Engineering, Medical Informatics, or a related quantitative or engineering field. A Ph.D. is welcome but not required. The candidate should have completed university-level coursework or equivalent practical training in:

* Probability, statistics, and experimental design
* Artificial intelligence, machine learning, and deep learning
* Linear algebra, optimization, and numerical methods
* Data structures, algorithms, and software programming
* Model evaluation, scientific methodology, and interpretation of empirical results

**Experience level:**

This is a junior R&D position. Relevant experience may have been gained through academic research, a thesis, internships, working-student assignments, or up to approximately three years of professional work in Data Science, machine learning, AI research, or AI/ML product development. Demonstrated hands-on experience in developing and scientifically evaluating AI/ML models is more important than a specific number of years.

**Desired Knowledge & Experience:**

* Sound understanding of machine learning, deep learning, statistical analysis, experimental design, and model evaluation.
* Active programming skills in Python and practical experience with libraries and frameworks such as NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras.
* Hands-on experience with the development workflow of AI/ML models, including data preparation, training, tuning, evaluation, error analysis, reproducibility, and documentation.
* Ability to define meaningful performance metrics, evaluation cohorts, subgroup analyses, test methods, and acceptance criteria for the intended use of an AI/ML algorithm.
* Understanding of data quality, representativeness, bias, annotation quality, data provenance, and traceability in AI/ML development.
* Knowledge of Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) concepts and tooling, including source and data versioning, reproducible pipelines, experiment tracking, automated testing, CI/CD, deployment, and monitoring.
* Hands-on exposure to current Large Language Models and Generative AI, including foundation models, prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, and model adaptation or fine-tuning.
* Knowledge of Agentic AI, including tool-using models, multi-step workflows, orchestration, memory, and autonomous or semi-autonomous decision paths, is an advantage.
* Experience or strong interest in the systematic evaluation of LLM, Generative AI, and Agentic AI systems, including task-specific benchmarks, groundedness and factuality, robustness, reproducibility, human evaluation, safety and guardrail testing, tool-use correctness, and analysis of failure modes.
* Experience with databases and query languages such as SQL; knowledge of Kusto Query Language, Snowflake, or graph databases such as Neo4j is an advantage.
* Exposure to cloud-based data and AI environments, preferably Microsoft Azure, such as Azure Blob Storage, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Monitor, or Azure DevOps.
* Experience with structured and unstructured data, for example machine logs, event data, Parquet files, text data, or multimodal data.
* Knowledge of healthcare, medical technology, clinical data, or interoperability standards such as DICOM is preferred.
* Basic project management skills and familiarity with working in cross-functional R&D or product-development teams.

**Required Soft Skills & Other Capabilities:**

* Scientific mindset, strong analytical ability, and attention to detail.
* Commitment to objective evidence, reproducibility, traceability, data integrity, and responsible AI development.
* Curiosity and resilience to investigate unexpected results, challenge assumptions, and improve models based on evidence.
* Collaborative approach to working with Data Scientists, domain experts, software engineers, product management, and quality and regulatory stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently within an agreed scope and to seek guidance when technical, scientific, product, or regulatory implications require alignment.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to explain methods, results, uncertainties, limitations, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Senior Data Scientist I
description:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description**

**About the Role**

The Senior Data Analyst I develops analytic solutions that provide transparency to and enable critical business decisions regarding panel health, sample performance, and operational efficiency. In this role, you will apply a strong mathematical and statistical background to build predictive and prescriptive models aimed at optimizing operational spending—specifically reducing panelist incentives and operational costs without impacting panel performance, data quality, or core KPIs. Additionally, you will play a key role in tool migration initiatives, decoding complex logic from legacy workflows and data pipelines and re-engineering them into modern analytics frameworks. The ideal candidate brings 5+ years of experience, exhibits excellent project leadership skills, and communicates complex statistical insights clearly across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 **Qualifications**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Statistical Modeling & Cost Optimization: Apply advanced statistical methods, rate forecasting, and predictive modeling to identify cost-saving opportunities across panel operations, specifically driving reductions in panelist incentive costs while maintaining data integrity and key performance metrics.
* Tool Migration & Logic Decoding: Work closely with stakeholders to decode, reverse-engineer, and document complex business logic embedded within legacy workflows and data pipelines, successfully converting and migrating them into new analytics tools and console frameworks.
* Independent Project Leadership: Lead analytics projects independently from conception to deployment, managing project timelines, production support, and the delivery of business-critical solutions.
* Process Automation & Tech Debt Reduction: Design, automate, and optimize analytics tools to better plan, predict, and monitor sample performance, significantly reducing tech debt associated with legacy architectures.
* Business Intelligence & Insights: Conduct research and quantitative analysis using descriptive, prescriptive, and statistical methods to deliver actionable insights and executive dashboards for business stakeholders.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align analytics workflows, implement data governance processes, and ensure timely issue resolution and production delivery.

  
**Additional Information**

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
* Experience: 5+ years of experience in quantitative analysis, data science, data analytics, or operations research.
* Statistical Mastery: Strong background in statistical modeling and testing procedures (e.g., A/B testing, ANOVA, Regression, Time Series, Correlation, and hypothesis testing).
* **Technical & Migration Skills:**
* 5+ years querying large relational databases using SQL (e.g., PostgreSQL, Oracle).
* 5+ years using scripting languages for data manipulation and statistical modeling (e.g., Python with SciPy, NumPy, and Pandas).
* 5+ years in data integration, analytics workflow conversion, and ETL tools (e.g., Alteryx, Databricks).
* 5+ years developing visualizations and executive dashboards using tools such as Tableau or BI platforms
* **Communication & Leadership Competencies:**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a proven ability to explain complex statistical concepts to non-technical audiences concisely.
* Ability to lead projects independently, prioritize multiple assignments, and solve complex problems in time-critical environments.
* Strong attention to detail, commitment to data quality, and proactive drive for process improvement.

**Optional Qualifications**

* Experience with process improvement methodologies such as Lean or Six Sigma.
* Familiarity with Agile project management tools (Jira, Confluence, or Smartsheets).
* Alteryx Core Certification or experience working with cloud ecosystems (Databricks, AWS).

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Data Science Trainer
description:
**Job Description: Data Science Trainer**

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a passionate and knowledgeable Data Science Trainer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in the field of data science, including practical knowledge of data analysis, machine learning, and statistical modelling. The trainer will be responsible for designing and delivering comprehensive training programs that cater to the needs of students or professionals looking to enhance their skills in data science.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Training Delivery:** Conduct engaging and interactive training sessions on various data science topics, including but not limited to Python, R, SQL, machine learning, data visualization, and statistical analysis.
* **Curriculum Development:** Design and update course materials, including presentations, assignments, projects, and assessments to ensure they are current and relevant.
* **Hands-on Projects:** Develop practical, real-world projects and case studies to provide hands-on experience to learners.
* **Assessment & Feedback:** Evaluate students’ progress through assignments, projects, and exams, providing constructive feedback to help them improve.
* **Stay Updated:** Keep abreast of the latest trends and technologies in data science to ensure the training content remains cutting-edge.
* **Mentorship:** Provide guidance and support to students, helping them with career advice, resume building, and interview preparation.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with other trainers and team members to ensure a cohesive learning experience.

**Qualifications**

* **Educational Background:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field. Ph.D. is a plus.
* **Experience:** At least 1-3 years of hands-on experience in data science roles. Prior experience in teaching or training is highly desirable.
* **Technical Skills:** Proficiency in Python, R, SQL, and familiarity with data science libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, and Keras. Knowledge of data visualization tools like Tableau or Power BI is a plus.
* **Soft Skills:** Excellent communication and presentation skills. Ability to explain complex concepts in a simple and clear manner.
* **Certifications:** Relevant certifications (e.g., Certified Data Scientist, Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate) are an advantage.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:

---------------

We are seeking a stellar Machine Learning scientist who has 1+ years of industry experience developing and shipping large scale ML products with visible customer impact. We would prefer if your previous work has been in developing scalable Agentic, RL or forecasting systems. Strong academic background in Statistics, Machine Learning & Deep Learning is required with Tier -1 publications being a plus.  
  
  
  
  
Key job responsibilities

About the team  
Millions of Sellers list their products for sale on the Amazon Marketplace. Sellers are a critical part of Amazon’s ecosystem to deliver on our vision of offering the Earth’s largest selection and lowest prices. In this ecosystem our team plays a critical role in enabling Sellers across EU5, China, Japan, Australia, Brazil and Turkey to make their Selection available to customers globally and deliver the experience they have come to expect from Amazon.  
  
In Jeff’s own words (2019 Q1 shareholders letter): “Something strange and remarkable has happened over the last 20 years. Take a look at these numbers: 1999 - 3% …… 2018 - 58%. The % represent the share of physical gross merchandise sales sold on Amazon by independent third-party sellers – mostly small- and medium-sized businesses – as opposed to Amazon retail's own first party sales. Third-party sales have grown from 3% of the total to 58%. To put it bluntly: Third-party sellers are kicking our first party butt. Badly.…. Why were independent sellers able to grow so much faster than Amazon's own highly organized first-party sales organization? There isn't one answer, but we do know one extremely important part of the answer: We helped independent sellers compete against our first-party business by investing in and offering them the very best selling tools we could imagine and build.
  
Our team is pushing the boundaries of these machine learning tools in areas of Agentic, recommendation and forecasting systems to help our sellers sell more and across borders.
